description:
Thickened Sponge Seats
Perfect solution to the hip fatigue caused by two people after a long ride.
It can prevent hip injuries when encountering severe bumps on the road.

Foldable Electric Bike
Simple folding, you can easily put it in the trunk.
With adjustable stem and seat, it can be adjusted according to different body types.

LCD Display & 3 Speed Modes
The LCD display can clearly display the battery level, speed, working mode, riding distance, etc.
You can choose the speed that suits you through the "M" button next to it: M1, M2, M3.

14" Puncture Resistant Tires
Prevents thorns, glass and other small materials from piercing, giving you stability, shock absorption and a smoother riding experience.

Integrated Headlight
It can help you light the way ahead in the dark.

USB Charging Port
The bike can charge your phone at any time, so you never have to worry about running out of battery while you ride.

【High Quality Motor & Battery Durability】 The electric bike for adults is equipped with a 48V 15Ah high capacity lithium battery, can travel 32 miles per charge in pure power mode (Volunteer weighs 154 pounds), easily enough for your day's use, and is removable The battery has the characteristics of long life, high durability, anti-theft and convenience. The high-quality 400W motor can reach a maximum speed of 22KPH, which can easily conquer 25% slope.
【Multiple Shock Absorption Design】 EBKAROCY adult electric bicycle is designed with four shock absorption areas, namely Mid-Mounted Shock Absorber, Hydraulic Shock Absorber, Seat Pack double spring shock, Riser Spring shock, no need to worry when you face bumpy roads . The interaction of the shock absorbers can reduce the physical discomfort of riding, allowing you to ride comfortably in the city. adult bicycles for women, youth and men.
【Absolute Safety & Absolute Comfort】 We use high-cost high-carbon steel material to make the body, which is characterized by high hardness, high durability, and strong shock absorption to ensure the safety of the body. The seat is made of high-density sponge material, which is characterized by softness and strong resilience, which can well relieve hip fatigue after long-term driving and give you the ultimate riding experience.
【Foldable & Convenient Design】 EBKAROCY electric bike is designed to be foldable. It measures 27x17x26 inches folded and weighs just 55 pounds, and the seat and handlebar can also be height-adjusted to everyone’s preferences. We have designed 3 speed gears, you can click "M" next to the LCD display to easily set and choose the speed you like. The design of the mobile phone holder brings you more convenience and safety, and you no longer have to worry about someone calling you while driving.
【Reliable Brand】Every ebike has been tested and screened out, we put quality control first, and we are committed to giving customers the best quality products. folding electric bike would arrive 95% assembled, you don't have to worry about wasting time on complicated assembly, 100% customer satisfaction is the top priority of our team, We offer you a 90-day warranty with free replacement parts., and give the most sincere attitude to serve customers. If you have any questions, please contact us!
